name: Charlotte to Takarabako
source: Charlotte is a novice treasure hunter who has come to a certain town. As she adventures in search of treasure hidden in town, an obscene shadow creeps up on her. Slime rape, tentacle rape, orc rape, and many other monsters attack her innocent honeypot in an obscene inter-species sex fantasy ADV in an attempt to impregnate her!
